cd __WORKSPACE__ && python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re, datetime, html
p='tobot-inbox/01a166d4-8530-7272-b357-e7c9ddf7ee4b/TC06_客户跟进记录_待清洗.xlsx'
z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
sh=z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
rows=re.findall(r'<row r="(\d+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>', sh, re.S)
for rn, body in rows:
    out=[]
    for cell in re.findall(r'<c r="([A-F]\d+)"([^>]*)>(.*?)</c>|<c r="([A-F]\d+)"([^>]*)/>', body, re.S):
        ref=cell[0] or cell[3]; attrs=cell[1] or cell[4]; inner=cell[2]
        t=re.search(r't="([^"]+)"',attrs)
        v=re.search(r'<v>(.*?)</v>',inner)
        it=re.search(r'<is><t>(.*?)</t></is>',inner)
        val = html.unescape(it.group(1)) if it else (v.group(1) if v else '')
        out.append(f"{ref}={val!r}({t.group(1) if t else 'n'})")
    print(rn, ' | '.join(out))
print()
for s in (46030,46035,46027,46036):
    print(s, datetime.date(1899,12,30)+datetime.timedelta(days=s))
EOF
